description: This file defines CLI commands for the Playwright testing framework, including test execution, report generation, server management, and agent initialization. It imports various modules for configuration, reporting, server control, and agent setup, and contains functions to add specific commands to a CLI program.

classes.name: TestServerBackend
classes.description: Backend implementation for the test server over MCP protocol.

methods.name: addTestCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'test' command to the CLI program, with options for running tests and filtering.

methods.name: addClearCacheCommand
methods.description: Adds command to clear build and test caches.

methods.name: addDevServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to start the development server.

methods.name: addTestServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to start the test server.

methods.name: addShowReportCommand
methods.description: Adds command to display HTML reports.

methods.name: addMergeReportsCommand
methods.description: Adds command to merge multiple blob reports into a single report.

methods.name: addBrowserMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to interact with the browser over MCP.

methods.name: addTestMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to interact with the test runner over MCP.

methods.name: addInitAgentsCommand
methods.description: Adds command to initialize repository agents.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Executes the test suite with given arguments and options, handling different modes like UI, watch, or full run.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts the test server with specified options.

methods.name: mergeReports
methods.description: Merges multiple report files into a single report.

methods.name: overridesFromOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration overrides based on CLI options.

methods.name: resolveReporterOption
methods.description: Resolves reporter string into reporter description objects.

methods.name: resolveShardOption
methods.description: Parses and validates shard option in 'current/total' format.

methods.name: resolveReporter
methods.description: Resolves reporter ID or path to a reporter implementation.
